_doc: Pons Garden flora roster. Original IP only (I-9). Every name must pass the 'someone stole my ___' test. status=exemplar comes from the bible; status=candidate is harness-generated for Benjamin to curate (D-5). sapBase per §3.1.

species.name: Gorbulon Sprig
species.silhouette: smug bean sprout with one enormous eyebrow
species.flavor: It knows something. It will not say what.

species.name: Plain Gerald
species.silhouette: an onion bulb with a single hair
species.flavor: Gerald is doing his best.

species.name: Bogwort
species.silhouette: a pea pod that is visibly damp
species.flavor: Found in a bog. Wants to go back.

species.name: Mildly Concerned Radish
species.silhouette: round red radish, brow furrowed
species.flavor: Everything is probably fine.

species.name: Weeping Wumbus
species.silhouette: melon that cries Sap tears into its own pot
species.flavor: The tears are Sap. Please do not ask why.

species.name: Clammy Pete
species.silhouette: a short cactus with a nervous smile
species.flavor: Pete would like a hug and cannot have one.

species.name: Tulip of Low Ambition
species.silhouette: a tulip leaning slightly away from the sun
species.flavor: It has plans. Tomorrow, maybe.

species.name: The Corn That Knows
species.silhouette: an ear of corn with narrowed eyes
species.flavor: It has seen your browser history.

species.name: The Unlicensed Carrot
species.silhouette: carrot in a tiny suit holding a briefcase that won't open
species.flavor: Not a lawyer. Has never claimed to be a lawyer.

species.name: Pumpkin, Esquire
species.silhouette: a pumpkin with a monocle and no explanation
species.flavor: Will be addressed correctly or not at all.

species.name: Bartholomew Bean
species.silhouette: a berry bush that insists it is a bean
species.flavor: The berries are, legally, beans.

species.name: The Sunflower Who Lied
species.silhouette: a sunflower facing firmly away from the sun
species.flavor: It said it was facing the sun. It was not.

species.name: Sir Blombus of the Damp
species.silhouette: knighted mushroom, visibly moist, tiny sword
species.flavor: Sworn to protect the plot. Slightly wet.

species.name: Duchess Turnip the Third
species.silhouette: a turnip wearing the smallest crown
species.flavor: The first two Duchesses are not discussed.

species.name: Grabby Bertrand
species.silhouette: a flytrap with a gap-toothed grin
species.flavor: Bertrand does not bite. Bertrand grabs.

species.name: The Pineapple Enforcer
species.silhouette: a pineapple with folded leaf-arms
species.flavor: Nobody steals on the Enforcer's watch. Somebody will try.

species.name: Fraudulent Orchid
species.silhouette: obviously two ferns in a trench coat
species.flavor: It is one orchid. Do not look at the coat.

species.name: Lord Eggplant Ascendant
species.silhouette: an eggplant floating one pixel above its plot
species.flavor: Has transcended soil. Still needs watering.

species.name: The Bamboo Inspector
species.silhouette: three bamboo stalks with a clipboard
species.flavor: Your garden has been noted.

species.name: YELLING TUBER
species.silhouette: potato. It yells. That's it.
species.flavor: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA.
